headline: Government Sets Maximum Rents in Affordable Rental: See the Values in Alentejo
summary: Maximum rent limits under the Simplified Affordable Rental Regime, set by municipality and typology, cover Alentejo's 47 municipalities. The ordinance takes effect on 14 October.
why: Rent caps under affordable-rental schemes affect residential property returns and the housing market, influencing landlords and developers.
